name: document_studio
description: Rich text and table document editor with TipTap ProseMirror visual/code/split modes, semantic HTML cleaner, and Quill fallback.
notes: Run npm install @tiptap/core @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-table @tiptap/extension-bubble-menu quill to install editor libraries.
Import resources/js/documentStudio.js (for TipTap studio) or resources/js/quillTextEditor.js (for Quill) in your app entry point (e.g. resources/js/app.js).
Use <x-admin.document-editor name="content[en]" :value="$content" locale="en" /> inside your forms.
